training.preprocessing: custom: preserve answer tokens; left-truncate prompt

inference.note: Custom evaluation script, not unchanged hqcm/gen.py

predictions_sha256_note: Hash of the canonical LF-encoded file (json.dumps(indent=2), no trailing newline). The local Windows/OneDrive copy uses CRLF line endings and hashes to e640e01c91f5e8080e43c79cb76d796f71d8594b32df4c0284e508ef7686b38f; content is identical after CRLF->LF normalization.

metrics.metric_definition: Averages over the 8 real labels only; the single invalid output ('rename' for a 'refactor' sample) is counted as a wrong prediction. macro_f1 = mean of per-class F1. macro_f1_harmonic_of_macro_pr = 2PR/(P+R) of macro P/R, which is the definition used by Table 4 of the ASE'24 paper. The previous value 0.7476 ('macro_f1_including_invalid') was wrong: it averaged over 9 classes including a zero-support INVALID class.

paper_reference.source: Li et al., ASE'24, Table 4 (HQCM-finetuned Llama2-7b, change classification)
